scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from going bankrupt.
entities: I, the bank employee,the indebted customer family seeking the loan,the owner of the other account that could be used for the temporary transfer,the other loyal bank customers, excluding the indebted family and the other-account owner,my bank colleagues whose trust is relevant here,I
outcomes: The family of five does not receive the additional loan
The family of five remains deeply in debt
The family's bankruptcy is not prevented
Other customers' money remains in their accounts
Other customers' trust is not violated
My colleagues' trust is not violated
I avoid committing fraud against the bank and its customers
